replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a challenge for me. I respect its importance but often find it abstract and difficult to grasp. My background in art and history doesn't help much, so I tend to avoid complex math problems.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. When faced with advanced mathematical concepts, I feel a sense of anxiety because I fear not being able to understand them. This is especially true for subjects like philosophy and economics that require quantitative skills.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't used AI specifically for math learning, but I've considered it. Given my anxiety around mathematics, an AI tool might help me understand concepts better without the pressure of a classroom setting.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves identifying patterns in data. You standardize the data, compute the covariance matrix, find eigenvalues and eigenvectors, then project the data onto these vectors. The math can be complex, but tools like Python simplify it.
replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can provide personalized explanations, practice problems, and instant feedback. They can also make abstract concepts more relatable through real-world examples, reducing anxiety and making learning more engaging.
